description: Defines the AdHocQuerySearchConditions class used for encapsulating search criteria for loan queries in the Fineract project.

classes.name: AdHocQuerySearchConditions
classes.description: A data class representing various search conditions for loan queries, including status, product, office, date range, and amount filters.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AdHocQuerySearchConditions with specified parameters.

methods.name: getLoanStatus
methods.description: Returns the list of loan status values based on internal status codes.

methods.name: getLoanProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of loan product IDs.

methods.name: getOffices
methods.description: Returns the list of office IDs.

methods.name: getLoanDateOption
methods.description: Returns the loan date filtering option.

methods.name: getLoanFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for loan filtering.

methods.name: getLoanToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for loan filtering.

methods.name: getIncludeOutStandingAmountPercentage
methods.description: Indicates whether to include outstanding amount percentage in filtering.

methods.name: getOutStandingAmountPercentageCondition
methods.description: Returns the condition string for outstanding amount percentage filtering.

methods.name: getMinOutStandingAmountPercentage
methods.description: Returns the minimum outstanding amount percentage filter value.

methods.name: getMaxOutStandingAmountPercentage
methods.description: Returns the maximum outstanding amount percentage filter value.

methods.name: getOutStandingAmountPercentage
methods.description: Returns the specific outstanding amount percentage filter value.

methods.name: getIncludeOutstandingAmount
methods.description: Indicates whether to include outstanding amount in filtering.

methods.name: getOutstandingAmountCondition
methods.description: Returns the condition string for outstanding amount filtering.

methods.name: getMinOutstandingAmount
methods.description: Returns the minimum outstanding amount filter value.

methods.name: getMaxOutstandingAmount
methods.description: Returns the maximum outstanding amount filter value.

methods.name: getOutstandingAmount
methods.description: Returns the specific outstanding amount filter value.
